review: Source polygons and color predicates were selected by visual source review independently of reconstruction. Pink outlined lettering includes its white fill and protects visible artwork between glyphs beyond an eight-pixel margin. The small 269 label includes connected gray antialias pixels. Other controls label lettering cores and protect pixels outside the source polygon plus a five-pixel antialias margin. Recorded pixel rotations inherit source annotations. These are assistant-reviewed masks, not human gold.

provenance.annotation: Manually reviewed target print. HOTCHEF green>130/min>120/chroma<75; GAME BOY min>140/chroma<40. IKUJI excludes the separate microprint above and curved rule below (local y8..43, whole isolated source components), with the separately connected crossing rule protected. Other dark lettering maxRGB<140. Outside the quad plus 8px is protected. Masks are independent of restoration.
